TECHNICAL
WHAT: Pixel art renderer uses painter's algorithm sorted by ty (tile y). PCs placed at deskY-1 draw before desks at deskY, so desks cover PCs.
WHERE: src/game/renderer.ts — bgItems render pass
HOW: Split furniture into three render passes:
1. Desks (ty sort)
2. PCs (ty sort, after desks)
3. Other bg furniture
PCs also use offsetY: 12 to position base of PC sprite flush on desk surface (16px = too low, 8px = too high, 12px = correct)
WHY: sprites are larger than a single tile, so painter's algorithm by tile position alone doesn't handle vertical overlap correctly
GOTCHA: furniture cache (buildFurniturePlacements) is cached at module level — must invalidate cache key or force rebuild when layout changes, otherwise old layout persists after hot reload
